title: fix: classify upstream finish errors
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Records text responses with `finish_reason: "error"` as non-billed 502 generation failures
- Preserves the upstream HTTP status and response body unchanged
- Applies the protocol check to every text provider
- Removes the temporary OpenRouter-only zero/missing-usage anomaly logger
- Keeps generic missing-usage and known flat-fee billing behavior unchanged

gist.headline: Errors stop collecting pollen
gist.blurb: The text gateway now recognizes when an upstream model finishes with an error, even if the stream looked otherwise complete. Those failed generations are kept as failures, not mysteriously billed adventures.
gist.summary: Text responses from every provider with `finish_reason: "error"` are now recorded as non-billed 502 generation failures while preserving the upstream HTTP status and response body unchanged.
gist.impact: Users and developers get accurate non-billed handling for upstream text-generation failures across providers, while normal missing-usage and flat-fee billing behavior stays the same.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden-terminal scene where Polli acts as a careful mail sorter, placing an upstream response marked with a tiny pixel "ERROR" stamp into a clearly labeled non-billed failure tray while healthy text-response seedlings continue growing normally. A CRT monitor robot can display the preserved response message, with flowers and code-plants showing that the gateway handles all provider streams consistently.
